latest_release.body:
## tvOS Beta 3.5.2

> **Install:** [NuvioTV-3.5.2-unsigned-release.ipa](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/releases/download/tvos-beta-3.5.2/NuvioTV-3.5.2-unsigned-release.ipa) requires a compatible tvOS development or sideloading signing workflow before installation.

> **New beta alerts:** [Manage notifications](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/subscription) → choose **Custom → Releases** · [Report a bug or suggest an idea](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/issues/new/choose)

> **Join the community:** [NuvioTVOS Discord](https://discord.gg/2YnNr2xmnJ) — chat, get help, report bugs, and share ideas.

### Plex Media Server Integration

- **Native Plex Integration:** Connect your Plex Media Server directly to Apple TV with multi-user Plex Home support and watch status synchronization.
- **Intro & Credits Skip Markers:** Automatically skips intros and credits using Plex timeline markers.
- **Plex Stream Labels & Audio Tracks:** Streams reflect native Plex version names, quality tiers, and track titles.
- **Top Shelf & Continue Watching:** In-progress Plex media merges seamlessly into Continue Watching and the Apple TV Top Shelf carousel.

### Unified Library "Servers" Tab

- **All Media Servers in One Hub:** Added a dedicated **Servers** tab inside Library aggregating **Plex**, **Jellyfin**, and **SMB** shares into one unified browsing interface.

### AI-Powered "Surprise Me" & "For You" Catalogs

- **Smart "Surprise Me" Discovery:** Instant movie and series recommendations powered by your watch history across connected trackers (Trakt, Simkl, AniList, MAL).
- **Custom AI Engine Choice:** Select from leading models (Gemini Flash, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Qwen) in Settings.
- **AI-Curated "For You" Rows:** Dynamically generated recommendation rows on the Home screen, including dedicated rows for Anime Movies and Anime Series.

### Episode Shuffle Play

- **Series Shuffle Play:** Effortlessly shuffle TV show episodes from the series Details screen or from within the in-player Episodes panel.
- **Persistent State:** Shuffle state is preserved across app sessions and integrates cleanly with Continue Watching.

### AIOStreams & JavaScript Add-on Plugins

- **Embedded AIOStreams Scraper:** Direct integration for AIOStreams scraper configurations.
- **On-Device JS Plugins:** Execute Nuvio JavaScript add-on plugins locally on Apple TV with synced stream filtering.

### Ambient Mode Screen Saver

- **Cinematic Idle Display:** Automatically transitions to full-bleed backdrop artwork and metadata highlights when idle, dismissing instantly on any remote interaction.

### Playback Finish Time & Stream Recommendations

- **Estimated Finish Time:** Displays the exact wall-clock completion time for the current movie or episode in the player HUD.
- **Nuvio Recommended Streams:** Ranks streams with prominent badges highlighting the best overall pick and best pick per resolution, factoring in seeders and throughput.
- **Stream Name Filtering:** Filter out unwanted keywords, tags, or release groups in the source selector.

### Navigation, Stream Resolution & Stability Polish

- **Canonical Stream ID Resolution:** Automatically resolves non-canonical TMDB identifiers (`tmdb:...`) to canonical IMDb stream IDs, ensuring seamless stream resolution and prefetching.
- **Source Picker Focus Retention:** Preserves remote focus on the selected source while slower add-ons continue loading in the background.
- **Playback Exit Hardening:** Exits the player cleanly when media finishes with no subsequent episode in queue.
- **Single-Episode Duration Validation:** Scopes expired link detection strictly to the active episode.
- **Jellyfin Rate-Limit Recovery:** Respects server `Retry-After` headers and prevents orphaned pagination states.
- **Session & Keychain Isolation:** Explicitly purges session tokens on sign-out and secures Trakt credentials in Apple TV Keychain.

detail.readme:
Chat, get help, report bugs, and share feature ideas.



Nuvio TV for tvOS

A modern Apple TV media player for browsing catalogs and playing user-configured sources.
SwiftUI tvOS shell - catalog browsing - AetherEngine / MPVKit playback

Download the latest Apple TV `.ipa` from [Releases](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/releases), then sideload it with Xcode, Apple Configurator, or your preferred tool. See the release notes for known issues. > **AltStore / SideStore / Feather Source:** Add `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/main/apps.json` · [Add to AltStore](altstore://source?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/main/apps.json) · [Add to SideStore](sidestore://source?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/main/apps.json) > **New beta alerts:** [Manage notifications](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/subscription) → choose **Custom → Releases**. ## Latest tvOS Beta **Beta 3.5.2** is the latest tvOS release. [Quick download (.ipa)](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/releases/download/tvos-beta-3.5.2/NuvioTV-3.5.2-unsigned-release.ipa) · [Read the release notes](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/releases/tag/tvos-beta-3.5.2) · [Report a bug or suggest an idea](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/issues/new/choose) The IPA requires a compatible tvOS development or sideloading signing workflow before installation. ### New in Beta 3.5.2 - **Plex Media Server Integration:** Connect your Plex Media Server directly to Apple TV with multi-user Plex Home support, intro/credits skip markers, Plex stream labels, and Top Shelf/Continue Watching sync. - **Unified Library "Servers" Tab:** Dedicated Servers tab inside Library aggregating Plex, Jellyfin, and SMB shares into one unified browsing interface. - **AI "Surprise Me" & "For You" Catalogs:** AI-curated discovery across Trakt, Simkl, AniList, and MAL watch history with customizable AI engines (Gemini Flash, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Qwen). - **Episode Shuffle Play:** Shuffle TV show episodes effortlessly from the series Details view or in-player Episodes shelf. - **AIOStreams & JS Plugins:** Direct integration for AIOStreams scraper configurations and local execution of JavaScript add-on plugins. - **Ambient Mode Screen Saver:** Full-bleed cinematic backdrop screensaver with metadata highlights when idle. - **Estimated Finish Time & Stream Recommendations:** Real-time clock completion time in HUD, best stream badges, and stream name keyword filtering. - **Navigation, Stream Resolution & Stability Polish:** Canonical IMDb stream ID resolution from TMDB, source picker focus retention, Jellyfin rate-limit recovery, and Keychain isolation. ### Built-in Player Nuvio's free built-in **AetherEngine** is the default in Auto mode. **MPVKit** is the one-way fallback, and either engine can be selected in Settings. - **Playback:** Native tvOS and Siri Remote controls, precise seeking and resume, saved audio and subtitle tracks, audio delay, frame-rate and dynamic-range matching, direct HTTPS and HLS streams, and custom HTTP headers. - **Video:** HDR10, HDR10+, HLG, Dolby Vision P5/P8, experimental full Dolby Vision P7 FEL, and optional MetalFX upscaling of sub-1080p SDR toward the display's resolution, with VideoToolbox/Neural Engine super-resolution when supported on compatible devices running tvOS 27.1+. - **Audio:** Dolby Atmos passthrough (E-AC3+JOC), channel fold-down, night-mode compression, and up to +12 dB dialogue lift with peak limiting. The optional lossless audio bridge converts supported non-streamable surround audio (TrueHD, DTS-HD MA, Opus) to up to 7.1-channel LPCM (24-bit for lossless sources; lossy inputs may be 16-bit) for compatible AVRs and eARC soundbars. When disabled, multichannel audio is bridged to Dolby Digital Plus with up to 5.1 channels for ARC compatibility. - **Subtitles and seeking:** Embedded and add-on text/PGS subtitles, authored ASS/SSA through AetherEngine's custom renderer, and thumbnail previews while scrubbing. Optional Seekr storyboards provide extra preview frames when configured. MPVKit handles separate audio/video URLs, audio amplification, and complex ASS/SSA typesetting. For supported 48 kHz TrueHD Atmos and DTS:X VOD, **Settings → Playback → Player → Atmos & DTS:X Spatial Audio (Beta)** opts into a fixed 9.1.6 render on tvOS 26+. It is off by default. The engine delivers 24-bit PCM to the system for HDMI and AirPods Spatial Audio, or lossy APAC for AirPlay; this is not TrueHD or DTS-HD bitstream passthrough. See [the spatial audio notes](docs/truehd-spatial-audio.md) for supported sources and fallback behavior. ### Supported Media Servers & Sources [Plex](https://plex.tv) · [Jellyfin](https://jellyfin.org) · SMB (NAS / Network Shares) · [Usenet (NNTP)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usenet) · [AIOStreams](https://github.com/Viren070/AIOStreams) · [Stremio Add-ons](https://stremio.com) ### Supported Tracking Services [Trakt](https://trakt.tv) · [Simkl](https://simkl.com) · [AniList](https://anilist.co) · [MyAnimeList](https://myanimelist.net) · [WeTrakr](https://wetrakr.com) · [MDBList](https://mdblist.com) ### Notes - Content availability depends on your configured sources and their upstream services. - The Apple TV Simulator cannot play AV1. ## About This project began with the Nuvio mobile app as its foundation. Since then, the tvOS version has grown into one of the best user-configured media players for Apple TV: a native SwiftUI app with catalog browsing, profiles, search, library and watchlist features, and playback controls designed for the Siri Remote. The shared mobile code remains in [composeApp](./composeApp), alongside the iOS app in [iosApp](./iosApp). Active tvOS development happens in [tvosApp/NuvioTV](./tvosApp/NuvioTV). ## Current tvOS App Native SwiftUI Apple TV app with configurable catalogs; profile-scoped Nuvio libraries, Plex servers, Jellyfin libraries, and SMB shares; Calendar and follows; and Watch Party. Top Shelf supports configurable content in carousel, landscape, and poster layouts. Optional Seekr seek previews show frames near the playhead. Playback uses AetherEngine, with MPVKit for demanding cases; the app also supports native Usenet/NNTP playback. See the [tvOS source](./tvosApp/NuvioTV) and [Tuist project](./tvosApp/Project.swift). ## Contributing Contributions are welcome; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md). ## Development Requires macOS, Xcode with an Apple TV simulator runtime, tvOS 18 or later, [mise](https://mise.jdx.dev) (tool version pinned in `mise.toml`), [Tuist](https://tuist.dev), and network access. The Xcode project is generated from [tvosApp/Project.swift](./tvosApp/Project.swift). Clone with submodules and generate the workspace: ```bash git clone --recurse-submodules NuvioTVOS cd NuvioTVOS mise install (cd tvosApp && tuist generate) ``` With an Apple TV simulator booted, run `./scripts/run-mobile.sh tvos s` or build the `NuvioTV` scheme in Xcode. ## Configuration & Tests Login is optional during development; the default Nuvio backend is configured for QR and email login. Unit tests are in [NuvioTVTests](./tvosApp/NuvioTVTests) and run with `scripts/test-tvos.sh`; UI tests use the separate `NuvioTV-UI` scheme. See the [UI validation notes](./tvosApp/NuvioTVUITests/README.md). ## Built With - SwiftUI and UIKit focus/input bridging for tvOS - AetherEngine and MPVKit playback engines - Configurable catalog, source, and subtitle APIs - Kotlin Multiplatform / Compose Multiplatform code from the original mobile app ## Legal & DMCA Nuvio functions solely as a client-side interface for browsing metadata and playing media provided by user-configured sources. It is intended for content the user owns or is otherwise authorized to access. Nuvio is not affiliated with any third-party extensions, catalogs, sources, or content providers. It does not host, store, or distribute any media content. For comprehensive legal information, including the full disclaimer, third-party extension policy, and DMCA/Copyright information, visit the [Legal & Disclaimer Page](https://nuvioapp.space/legal).
